title: Verify a finding before fixing it
statement: Before filing or fixing a finding, confirm it on the current, settled, live build, test the check that raised it on clean content, and publish how many were withdrawn.
example: In one audit, 9 of 12 serious findings were refuted with evidence.
detail: A rule-by-rule audit of one reading lesson ran nine independent audits and then an adversarial refutation pass, and 9 of 12 serious findings were refuted with evidence. A count of an interface audit's bug register put its false-positive rate at 6/65 = 9%, matching another audit lane's measured 8-15%. A benchmark's audit of an older version had 20 rows already fixed on the working branch. The check that raised a finding should also be tested on content known to be clean.
against: Both rates come from one project's own audits, so they are examples, not a constant. The reference test can bless a gap the references share: one finding was dismissed as an aspiration the approved references do not meet either (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-course/G3-U1-L4-RESIDUAL-ADJUDICATION-2026-08-21.md`). Findings also catch what checks miss: 26 findings from one review round landed on lessons the calibration log had marked green, findings the team's own passing gate missed (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0245-coe-sync-2026-08-31-cert-layer-portal-fixes.qmd`, lines 34-36).
